text:
erin: quick FYI — scheduling a config-only deploy tonight 01:00 UTC. scope prod-global (staged). changes: routing.default_policy -> latency-pref, batch_target 20 -> 10, tenant_default_rate 130r/s -> 95r/s, request_timeout_ms 14000 -> 10000. canary in us-west1 for 15m.

sam: noted. rollback criteria?

erin: rollback if p99 increases >22% for 10m OR 5xx >0.4% sustained 5m. also rollback on any single-host kvcache_evictions >180/min.

priya: I'll add synthetic checks hitting heavy seq routes and wire alerts. Also recommend setting kv_warm_ms=8000 on canary for 5m.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] cfg-2026-07-12-001 config-only -> canary(us-west1) at 1789012500

sre-lena: preflight done: redwoodctl config preview --env prod --file cfg-2026-07-12-001.json; smoke passed in staging.

erin: note in release notes: this is a config-only change to tighten shaping and reduce tail variance. per-route exceptions supported for high-seq tenants.

deploy-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-07-12-001 -> us-west1 at 1789012520

sam: initial canary metrics (5m): p95 210ms (base 200ms), p99 760ms (base 740ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alerts.

ops-kyle: recommend slow ramp: 3% -> 12% -> 40% -> 100% with manual sign-off at each gate. hold 12m after canary.

erin: agreed. manual gates and pager oncall.

priya: added dashboard panels: p95/p99, 5xx, evicts/min, per-tenant rate-limited counts, batch_util. thresholds set.

deploy-bot: [rollout] staged -> 3% at 1789012660

sre-lena: alert: evictions spike on eu-west hosts at 1789012725, correlated with tenant-heavy-42. p99 on those hosts up to 1.6s.

erin: pause ramp. ops-kyle hold further ramping.

ops-kyle: paused. routing fallback applied to eu-west to previous weighting.

sam: root cause: tenant-heavy-42 runs long sequences; reducing batch_target increased kv churn for them. propose per-route override: tenant-heavy-42.batch_target=20 and tenant-heavy-42.rate=180.

erin: prepare hotfix. that seems safer than global rollback.

deploy-bot: [hotfix queued] per-route override tenant-heavy-42 -> batch_target=20,rate=180 at 1789012800

sre-lena: hotfix applied. eu-west p99 fell to 730ms, 5xx returned to baseline.

erin: decision: no global rollback. keep global knobs but add per-route exception for tenant-heavy-42. update runbook: per-route override is first recovery knob for heterogeneous seq workloads.

ops-kyle: resume plan: continue from 3% -> 12% after 10m hold, manual checks at gate.

deploy-bot: [rollout resumed] -> 12% at 1789012860

priya: monitoring stable at 12% for 7m. synthetic probes show no regressions.

sam: good run. erin, please include note to DM tenants we've applied overrides to.

erin: will DM tenant-heavy-42 and mark release: cfg-2026-07-12-001. posting to #announcements after 100% + 30m healthy.

deploy-bot: [status] cfg-2026-07-12-001 at 12% as of 1789012950
